stem: All containers receive the same programmed irrigation volume, but moisture readings show one bench is consistently drier than the others. What is the best next investigation?
choices: Raise fertilizer EC on the drier bench because lower moisture usually indicates weaker nutrient concentration
Move the drier bench to a different cultivar group because genetic water use is the most likely cause
Lower room temperature across the crop until all benches reach the same moisture reading after irrigation
Check actual emitter output, placement, drainage, and media distribution on the consistently drier bench
rationale: Equal programmed volume does not guarantee equal delivery or retention. Irrigation uniformity, emitter placement, drainage and media properties should be checked against measured root-zone response.
